items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Milton Larkins. Oh yeah. Milton Larkins was here every week. Carolina Cotton Pickers.

ctx.x: We had a drummer, he used to use a drummer by a young boy named Milton. He felt around my age now but he was young then, you know.
Did he have any people like in Downsville that walk around in the street and play like guitar players?
